data.summary: Reviews are authentic and tell a consistent story of a long-established company (51 years) with a strong retail/sales front but a problematic and declining service/repair department. Positive reviews praise specific retail employees and quick help, while negative reviews consistently cite unresponsive service, long repair delays, poor communication, and declining work quality over recent years. The rating discrepancy reflects different customer experiences: retail vs. service.

positive_evidence: A-Quality did a great job handling my Polaris warranty inquiry

authentic_signals: Specific employee names mentioned (Rick, Logan, Brad, Braxton)
Detailed project descriptions (PebbleTec, heater installation, pump replacements)
Varied writing styles and emotional tones
Mix of praise for retail and criticism for service
data.discrepancy_explanation: Significant rating gap between Google (4.3) and Yelp (3.1). This is a common pattern where Google reviews are more positive, but the Yelp reviews reveal deeper service issues, particularly with repairs and responsiveness.

reviews.text: This is in response to the lack of attention Braxton one of ur pool cleaners has again failed to inform me of our actuators going out! Now 836 dollars later I’ve not only paid for a new Polaris, then a new pump, and all could have been told to me regarding Polaris and actuators! I would like to request someone else to clean my pool from this point on!
reviews.author: Mary Lenz

reviews.text: A-Quality did a great job handling my Polaris warranty inquiry, troubleshooting my Polaris low pressure issue and helping me isolate the problem to my booster supply pump for resolution. Took no more than 5 minutes over the phone. I’ve since scheduled the pool equipment repair service. Their customer service and support between their retail and pool service reps helped save me time and money chasing a Polaris solution unnecessarily. Thank y'all so much.
reviews.author: Tom Sisoian

reviews.text:
My experience with A-Quality pools has been anything but good. The sales person was very friendly but that is where it stopped.
The spa I purchased was in stock but yet could not be delivered for over a week because the installer was out of the office. You only have one person doing installs? Also told we can't deliver until we do a site inspection. It took them a week to come and do the site inspection, same guy is out of the office.
The spa is finally delivered. The front panel is cracked, the front latch is bent and broken, the back panel is damaged from the trailer they brought it on and two of the LED light housings are broken and I can't fill the tub!! Three weeks later I still don't have a functioning hot tub!! I have called no less that six times with zero results!!! lies on top of lies is all I get. They will not even tell me if the parts have been ordered or if they have when do they arrive. How long do I have to wait???
Run away, fast. These people will take your money and leave you hanging.
reviews.author: Scott Romine

reviews.text: AQuality Pools took their time to figure out what was wrong with my pool equipment after another company had said extra stuff needed replaced when it didn’t and saved me a lot of money.
reviews.author: Andrew Andersen

reviews.text: In working with Logan S I want to tell everyone this is the company to use. I’ve had my pool resurfaced, all electronics completely automated,  extremely knowledgeable Logan S will not let you down. THANK  YOU.
reviews.author: Brian Carpenter

reviews.text: I'm not sure what has happened to this place but it's definitely gone downhill. I dropped off my robot to be repaired Dec. 5th. I was told there were 8 others in front of mine and they should have it diagnosed by the end of the month. I paid the $75 fee and leave it there. I try to call mid Jan and no one answers, I leave a message, nothing, finally I stop by the store and I'm told they are just really backed up. Fast forward to now March, I call a few times to get an update and still no answer, I leave messages, and yet again, no one calls back.  Finally I stop by again to check on it. Once someone finally steps out from the back to help me, I'm told it's still waiting to be diagnosed. They've had my pool cleaner for 3 months and never even looked at it. I guess they can only work one at a time, what happened to " we will know something by the end of Dec ?". I will say that when I asked for my equipment back and a refund on the diagnostic fee they did not hesitate. By the frustration I could see on the employee's face, I could tell I'm not the only person bothered by their practices of late. Now I'm on the hunt for a new pool supply and repair store.
reviews.author: Jayson Mathewson

reviews.text:
I want to give a 10 star review for Rick.
He went above and beyond the line of duty helping me today.
He is professional, kind, caring and knows his business. Rick’s Follow up skills are awesome. Rick contacted me after I got home to make sure everything was ok.
If your looking for a good pool company with outstanding customer service and quality products, please give A Quality a try, you won’t use anyone else!
Thank you Rick!!
reviews.author: Deanne Harvey

reviews.text:
These folks are always ready to help you with issues with your pool, water ph chlorine issues, pump, filter and filter container.

A-Quality Pools prices are great.

They have it all and I highly endorse these guys for whatever your pool needs are.
reviews.author: Kurt Thiel

reviews.text:
I strongly advise against hiring this company. My experience with them has been extremely disappointing. Initially, they took over a year to install a heating system that cost $5,000. While they attributed the delay to pipeline issues and COVID-19, I was understanding at the time. However, my experience worsened with the next project: a PebbleTec installation costing over $10,000. Although the work was completed within a reasonable timeframe, the quality of the workmanship was severely lacking. The installation is marred by streaks, break points, and other defects, and the color is far from what was promised.

Despite my repeated attempts to contact the company via email, phone, and text over several months, they have been completely unresponsive. Their lack of accountability has left me with no choice but to involve legal counsel. This is no longer a matter for small claims court due to the significant amount involved.
reviews.author: Russell T

reviews.text:
I had broke off part of the metal pin in my Hayward backwash piston. Tried everything to get it out. Brought it over to Rick at A-Quality Pools. After about 20 minutes and five different tools and a lot of muscle, He was able to remove the cotter pin.
I offered to pay him, but it was no charge. You don't find that kind of customer service any more...willing to go the extra mile. Thank you A- Quality Pools!!!
reviews.author: Lee Reed

reviews.text: Everyone that I worked with at A-Quality has been great and very professional. Their knowledge on what I need is fantastic. Been doing Business with A-Quality for over twenty years and plan on continuing.  Their service department has took very good care of my pool.  The only problem with the the service department is everyone know how great their service technicians are, so they are usually back up for a week or more.
reviews.author: Daniel Russell

reviews.text:
Recent experience with A-1 Quality pools was exceptional. Bill and the tech he was training was straight forward, honest and quick to respond to get my pool pump back up and running! Work was great, Price was great which in return was just a great experience overall. Had parts on the shelf and even plumbed everything correctly unlike the local chain store!
Keep it local and support the ones that will support you with integrity and great pricing as well as give you their honest opinion! Thanks Bill and Team!
reviews.author: Rodney Meadows

reviews.text:
Gave them my pool sweep for Two weeks.
Never heard from them… I called several times for several days… no one answered and no one ever called me back. Picked up my sweep today not only not repaired.. but was never looked at. And No apologies for their lack of service .
reviews.author: Austin Prescott

reviews.text: We have been using this company for the majority of our pool services since we moved into our house in 2007.  We love to support local businesses which is why we continued for so long.  We have had really good techs in the past, but the most recent tech Brad, whom we have seen most often lately has finally moved us past using them anymore.  They/Brad does the least work possible which often means a bandaid for the symptom and not correcting the problem.   The good experiences we had in the past are now overshadowed by the bad service and support of poor quality after bringing it to their attention multiple times.
reviews.author: Erika Resener

reviews.text:
Lacking service department and terrible customer service to top it off. We took a part in for a known issue, they kept it for almost 2 weeks, said it was fixed and it was not. We got a second opinion to confirm. The customer service lady was consistently short and rude, and even critical of us getting a second opinion. Overall horrible experience.

We had a good experience with this business about a year ago. Sadly the quality has declined quickly.
reviews.author: Mila Hunt

reviews.text: They sent me a flyer for great prices and free estimates when I called in for appointment to have estimate was told like around 50.00 just to come out for estimate. First impressions are a big deal for me and after already being charged for a estimate I wont being doing any business with this company. They should be honest with flyers or not send them out.
reviews.author: Myron Martinez

reviews.text:
we've been using A-Quality for a dozen years now and just recently had them come out to replace our main pump.  they gave an honest opinion and suggestions, then did the work (in the rain) in about an hour.  he was very thorough with the explanation of a variable speed pump (the old one was single-speed) and even suggested we hold off on replacing the cleaner pump.
we made them our primary pool store when we couldn't get our water tested at leslie's without coming home with $100+ of chemicals.  they've been 100% honest.
reviews.author: John Leger

reviews.text: I've always had a good experience in sales with A-Quality. Haven't used their service as I already had someone for the same but I'd not hesitate taking my business there if and when the time comes. Friendly people and competitive prices with sales/coupons considering it's not a chain like Leslie's.
reviews.author: A D

reviews.text: The work they do is fine and professional. Their scheduling however is terrible. They give you a vague answer of how long it might take to come out or how much they are delayed with no specific appointment date. You just have to hope you are available or home when they call letting you know they're 20 minutes out or trust that they are doing the work you've paid for if you're not. On two separate occasions I waited 5 weeks for some basic service and both times had to call to basically remind them they had yet to come out 4 weeks after the initial call.
reviews.author: Jeff Marsicano

reviews.text: The lid to our pool filter shattered.  I called several pool supply companies and they either didn't have the part or wanted to sell me a whole unit for $1600.  Josh at A-Quality checked the supply room for the part and found it.  (I have an idea some of the other companies couldn't be bothered to check).  He was friendly, courtesous, and even carried the part out to my car.  I will definitely do business with them again.   It's so nice to be able to use a local company instead of Amazon.
reviews.author: Eric F

reviews.text: The service from this company continues to decline to the point that I am done.  I was upsold a new mac daddy cleaner (QUATTRO) May of 2020.  It has been back in the shop 3 times since.  That is more time combined than ever before in my 25 years of pool ownership.  I called and left multiple voicemails to get guidance on possibly fixing it myself but never got a return phone call.  This time I dropped it off (on Tues) and was told it would take 5-7 days repair only because the technician was out of town til Thursday.  When I called 10 days later, I was informed that they just ordered parts that day and were waiting for them to arrive (10 DAYS TO ORDER PARTS).  Nevertheless, I was assured they would overly communicate with me going forward.  Surprise but never got 1 single call.  2 weeks later, I went to  A-Quality to get my cleaner regardless of what state it was in.  I planned to take it elsewhere to get fixed.  After debunking 3 excuses in a row, she literally told me to sit tight for 5 minutes and she would get it ready for me.  I thought she was returning it to me unrepaired.  It was a 5 minute repair and she handed it back to me ready to go.  These folks care nothing about customer service anymore and they are obviously professional procrastinators.  Its really too bad
reviews.author: Jason Shawver

reviews.text: I always use A-Quality pools service for my pool maintenance needs for several years.  I am always very pleased with their work.  Last weekend I noticed the bottom manifold was broken on my Hayward cartridge.  I called in the office first thing this morning.  Brad with his team came by early this afternoon and replaced the manifold in less than an hour and fixed my problem.  I thank them very much.  They are always very friendly, professional in their work and kind.  Thank you all.   God bless you all. Regards,  Neset Onen
reviews.author: Neset Onen

reviews.text: Very knowledgeable and friendly staff.  Sorry, but need to amend.  Very, very dissatisfied with the service department. Still believe inside sales good, but cannot recommend service department.  Had them replace light, very sloppy, bad install.  Been complaining since, to no avail.  Still getting bills for what I already paid for and still not satisfied. I have to go with different company to get it done correctly.
reviews.author: John Cramer

reviews.text: I have dealt with A-Quality pool Service for about 5 years now for various repairs, and installation of a custom cover. They are outstanding, by far the best experience I have had with any pool company. Friendly, efficient service,  and they are always willing to explain things. The price is very reasonable and I recommend A-Quality pool service wholeheartedly.
reviews.author: Bob S

reviews.text: I have used A Quality for over 2 years. In the beginning they were good. Unfortunately I will no longer be using them. In  November they supposedly fixed an issue with one of my pumps, by replacing seals  in March only 4 months later they said the same pump is leaking and needs to be fixed. They did not even offer to cover what they or ready fixed. At the same time they put a pressure switch in my UV system surprise my UV system is still not working. Also I just recently found out that it should of been covered on my warranty for my UV system. They did not even send it for warrenty. They also charged me an hour and a half for the work that they did. So I chalk it up to a lesson learned and they are no longer my service company.
reviews.author: Irene Stephens

reviews.text: Brad and Shawn both are awesome. They have taken care of my pool for over 4 years and with no complaints. I also have the weekly service due to health reasons I’m not able to keep up with. Should you need service on equipment or weekly cleaning you can absolutely trust A-Quality Pools!!
reviews.author: Richard Shires

reviews.text: I made an appointment for pump repair after the huge winter storm. I understood that there would be a wait and all I asked was to be called the day before they were going to show up. I was driving 35 miles away from my home when I received a call from this company saying they were on their way. There was no way for them to get to my pool and was told if I rescheduled that I would be put back on the bottom of the list. I went to the store today and got into a yelling match with the owner. He has zero customer service skills and I would not use this place for any service on my pool even though they are one of the best around.
reviews.author: ohiobigguy

reviews.text: I don't understand all the negative comments on the feedback/experiences with A-Quality.  I have been a loyal customer of theirs for over 10 years, and ya'll must not be getting your pool serviced by Shawn Davis.....he's the BEST!   Always calls to let you know when he'll be there, he's energetic and explains everything in great detail.  A-Quality installed a brand new Pool Comp for my pool and everything was installed professionally and timely.  A-Quality has two meanings to their name:  A ---- Graded A in Service, Quality = Quality customer service.
reviews.author: Scott Everett
